title: Language of Thought Shapes Output Diversity in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cultural pluralism by computing the normalized entropy of model responses across country associations using the BLEND dataset and across diverse value orientations using the World Values Survey (WVS) dataset, measuring the representation of varied cultural perspectives versus dominant cultural homogenization.

Comparing the output diversity and cultural pluralism of models when restricted to English 'thinking' versus non-English and mixed-language 'thinking' to demonstrate the structural mode collapse and homogenization effect inherent in English-only intermediate reasoning.
